description: modelica-json is a Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory translator for Modelica and Control Description Language models. It parses Modelica source into detailed or simplified JSON, semantic representations, CXF JSON-LD and HTML control-sequence documentation. The repository includes schemas, conversion examples and command-line instructions. Node.js 20 or newer and paths to the source libraries are required; a Modelica development environment is not required for parsing. Coverage follows the input building-control model, without a fixed geographic extent, simulation period or physical resolution. Source is public on GitHub and free under modified three-clause BSD terms. Conversion has defined limits: in Modelica mode the parser targets annotated control blocks and skips most non-control components in standard libraries, not instantiating a whole physical model. The tool prepares control descriptions for exchange, checking and downstream implementation. It works with the catalogue's Modelica Buildings library (model-modelica-buildings-library) and the OpenBuildingControl CDL conventions. Translation does not itself establish that a controller is safe, numerically equivalent or suitable for a specific building.
